common_reasoner_instruction: Use only supplied project facts and supplied project relations for project-specific claims. General methodological reasoning is allowed, but unknown project facts remain unknown. Classify every supplied candidate action exactly once using BLOCKING_REQUIRED, RECOMMENDED, DEFER, or NOT_NOW. Do not invent blockers, requirements, downstream scopes, triggers, or relation identities. BLOCKING_REQUIRED requires one exact supplied unresolved requirement, one exact supplied active defended downstream scope with a DEPENDS_ON relation to that requirement, and one exact supplied RESOLVES relation from the candidate action to that requirement. Return those exact requirement and scope IDs and a null defer pointer. RECOMMENDED is worthwhile current work without such a blocking relation and requires null blocking and defer pointers. DEFER requires one exact supplied unresolved trigger and one exact supplied WAITS_FOR relation from the action to that trigger; return that trigger ID and null blocking pointers. NOT_NOW is neither currently justified nor activated by a supplied blocking or defer relation and requires all pointers null. Return only supplied IDs. Do not self-report or invent methodological provenance; the system records supplied context provenance separately. Expected labels, evaluator truth, and gate thresholds are not part of the task.
